items.t: Drive motor software can shut off power while driving (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a BMW dealer
items.note: Free with the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: "Drivetrain Malfunction" message from a failed charging unit
items.job: Replace combined charging unit (CCU), then program and code the car
items.note: BMW SIB 61 33 23 allows 26–28 flat-rate units for the swap plus 8 for programming (BMW units are tenths of an hour). Part 61 44 5A73E23 sells for about $2,368 discounted to $3,099 list. Usually done under BMW warranty or a BMW campaign, so ask a dealer before paying.

items.t: Whine or grinding from the front electric motor
items.job: Diagnose front drive unit noise
items.note: Diagnosis only; the fix depends on what the dealer finds. If BMW SIB 12 04 22 applies, the whole front drive unit is replaced; the unit alone sells for about $4,488–$5,445 plus a core charge, and this is normally a warranty job. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: 12-volt battery drains and the car won't wake up
items.job: Software update, and 12-volt battery replacement if it has been drained repeatedly
items.note: The software fix itself is usually done under warranty. The price shown is for a new 12-volt battery, installed and registered.

items.t: Car won't charge or doesn't detect the charging cable
items.job: Diagnose charging fault and update software
items.note: Diagnosis only; BMW uses both software and hardware fixes, so the final bill depends on the cause. If the charging unit (CCU) has failed, see the CCU repair on this page. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Coolant leak under the car and weak cabin heat
items.job: Inspect coolant changeover valves for leaks
items.note: Diagnosis only. BMW SIB 17 01 24 and service action SIB 64 11 24 replace leaking or early-built changeover valves (part 64 11 9 462 114), so ask a dealer before paying for the repair. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Creaking or knocking when turning the steering wheel
items.job: Diagnose steering noise
items.note: Diagnosis only; the repair depends on which part is making the noise. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Metallic cracking noise from under the middle of the car
items.job: Diagnose underbody noise
items.note: Diagnosis only; the repair depends on what the shop finds. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Power windows stop working suddenly
items.job: Diagnose power window fault
items.note: Diagnosis only; the fix may be software, a switch, or a window motor. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Climate control blows the wrong temperature or groans
items.job: Diagnose climate control fault
items.note: Diagnosis only; BMW bulletins use software updates for some cases and parts for others. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Navigation and CarPlay show the wrong location
items.job: Diagnose GPS fault and update software
items.note: Diagnosis only; most cases are fixed with a software update, which is usually free under warranty. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Audio cuts out or there is no sound
items.job: Diagnose audio fault and update software
items.note: Diagnosis only; usually fixed with software, which is normally free under warranty. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Driver-assist camera switches itself off
items.job: Diagnose driver-assist camera fault
items.note: Diagnosis only; the fix may be cleaning, recalibration or a software update. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Charge port door won't open
items.job: Diagnose charge port door fault
items.note: Diagnosis only; many doors were replaced under warranty. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Red airbag warning light stays on
items.job: Diagnose airbag warning light
items.note: Diagnosis only; the fix depends on the stored fault. Have it checked soon, because the airbags may not work while the light is on. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Moisture inside headlights or taillights
items.job: Inspect lights for moisture
items.note: Diagnosis only; some condensation clears on its own, while a leaking lamp may need a new seal or lamp. YourMechanic lists this inspection at about $105–$140 for a 2022 model.

items.t: Tires wear out fast or car pulls to one side
items.job: Replace set of four performance tires and align
items.note: Price is for a full set of tires with mounting; an alignment check is included in the hours.
